cc:Work.dc:description: (a) One audit versus two concurrent baseline recomputations on separate hosts, including public transfers but excluding signing, chain waits and decryption. (b) Top to bottom: proposed/correct, baseline/correct, proposed/faulty. Context and result certificates each use two workers. Context is counted once per alternative. Result checks/signing and FHE certify the full program (baseline) or disputed instruction (faulty task). CPU excludes operator, owners, chain, KMS and orchestration outside measured processes. Means from 30 pairs (a) and three cases (b,c). Error bars show sample SD. In (c), ticks mark on-chain rejection. Ranges: 182--183 blocks from disclosure request to challenge, 34--53 to rejection (216--236 from request), then 5 for unused bond releases and reward withdrawal. Blocks include phase waits.
